items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: the older Australian-style jazz band, which is based on the, the Lou Watters West Coast style.

ctx.x: What are the other Australian bands like in general?

At the current time, there seems to be a, a fair, uh, swing towards the, uh, pianoless rhythm section and the, uh, Lewis-style clarinet. Uh, of course, there's still plenty of the older Australian-style jazz band, which is based on the, the Lou Watters West Coast style. I think if there is an Australian jazz style, that is it, uh, as exemplified by Graham Bell, Frank Johnson, and other bands, which I can't think of at the moment. Southern Jazz Band. The Southern Jazz Band, that's right, Dave Dalwitz's band. Uh,…
How did Ken Collier get that? Whose idea was that?
